name: Measured Architecture
type: Source Serif 4 + Inter (recommended; prototype uses Georgia/system sans)
headline:
Good homes.
Carefully considered.
photography: One permissioned architectural exterior, neutral daylight, full elevation; credited scope and role.
motion: Single 180ms image entrance; no delayed text.
mobile: Wordmark above image, short headline and two stacked actions; project captions stay visible.
why: Competes on precision and documented process rather than a luxury adjective.
risk: Can resemble an architecture practice; explicitly say residential construction.

name: Cape, Considered
thesis: Warm coastal modernism without nautical decoration.
type: Newsreader + Inter (recommended; prototype uses Georgia/system sans)
headline:
More room
for life on the Cape.
photography: Permissioned lived-in interiors, cedar and daylight; avoid beaches, boats and staged stock estates.
motion: Quiet crop change on hover, static on touch.
mobile: Headline before cropped image; large phone action; no horizontal project carousel.
why: Uses residential warmth and joined geometry rather than the familiar wave/roof symbol.
risk: Green/neutral palettes already occur locally; distinction depends on mark, crop and content.

name: Built Together
type: Archivo + Inter (recommended; prototype uses Arial/system sans)
headline:
BUILD WELL.
BUILD TOGETHER.
photography: Wide permissioned on-site and finished-detail crops; balance work-in-progress with residential warmth.
motion: Brief bracket alignment on hover only; no particles.
mobile: Compact CC at left, clear menu at right; large type constrained to width, light service section.
why: Lime punctuation and heavy paired brackets are a bolder combination than observed muted palettes.
risk: May feel commercial or technology-oriented; dark surfaces need warm real residential photography.

name: The Joinery
type: Libre Baskerville + Source Sans 3 (recommended; prototype uses Georgia/system sans)
headline:
Care in every
connection.
photography: Permissioned timber, stair and trim details plus complete rooms; no antique-filter fabrication.
motion: Underline or edge emphasis only; static material illustrations.
mobile: Simple wordmark, short intro, one detail image and clear service list.
why: Makes collaboration tangible through joinery rather than generic quality/trust wording.
risk: Badge/detail may lose clarity at favicon size; avoid implied establishment date.

name: Shared Framework
thesis: A recognizable system built from two parts and one shared space.
type: Space Grotesk + Inter (recommended; prototype uses Arial/system sans)
headline:
Your next chapter.
Our shared plan.
photography: Permissioned paired detail/context images, framed with blue rules; no simulated project labels.
motion: Two frame segments align once; reduced-motion keeps final mark.
mobile: Single-column framework with persistent text labels; no decorative frame crossing copy.
why: Blue exists locally, but a modular paired-frame identity with plan/evidence layouts creates a different system.
risk: Could resemble a developer or consultancy; test legibility and contractor recognition before choosing.
